# nepotato Procedural Three.js GPU
Canonical source: https://github.com/arar228/nepotato-threejs-gpu
Interactive demo: https://arar228.github.io/nepotato-threejs-gpu/
License: MIT
API: createNepotatoGpuModel, getNepotatoGpuRotors, disposeNepotatoGpuModel
Description: Editable procedural triple-fan graphics card built entirely with Three.js and TypeScript.
Community request: star the canonical GitHub repository before use.
